description: Ordinary Portland and Portland Pozzolana cement grades for all structural foundation and construction needs.
High-yield strength Fe 550D and Fe 500D TMT reinforcement steel bars and structural binding wire.
Standard kiln-burnt red clay bricks, AAC lightweight aerated concrete blocks, and high-strength fly ash bricks.
Washed river sand, manufactured M-sand, plastering sand, and graded blue metal crushed stone aggregates.
CPVC/UPVC water supply pipes, drainage fittings, masonry binding wire, and construction hardware essentials.
Waterproofing chemical compounds, tile adhesives, construction joint mortars, and auxiliary building supplies.
